veranderings.rede: 'Hoor die antwoord' reads woodenly; 'luister na hulle antwoord' is the natural Afrikaans and echoes the listening the block teaches.

veranderings.voor: te groot vir een paar hande om alleen te doen
veranderings.na: te groot vir een persoon om alleen te doen
veranderings.rede: 'One pair of hands' is an English image that sounds translated in Afrikaans; 'een persoon' says the same plainly.

veranderings.voor: 'n taak wat hy goed kan doen
veranderings.na: 'n taak wat hy of sy goed kan doen
veranderings.rede: The leader is 'sy' throughout, so a bare 'hy' for 'elkeen' right after 'Sy' jars; the lesson already uses 'sy of haar' elsewhere.
'Die beste een' copies English 'the best one'; 'die beste daarvan' is the standard Afrikaans construction.

veranderings.blok: Dit is nie altyd maklik nie
veranderings.voor: 'n groep lei met baie werk en min tyd
veranderings.na: 'n groep lei wat baie werk en min tyd het
veranderings.rede: As written, 'met baie werk en min tyd' can attach to 'lei' (leading with much work); the relative clause makes clear it is the group that has the work and little time.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: In the list this item alone starts with a capital letter while the other seven start lower case; the capital looks like an inconsistency rather than a choice, and a person may want to align it (the words themselves stay).
